lede: Every Synthesia plan, how many credits each one gives you, and the cheapest plan for the AI avatar videos you make.
calc_label: Synthesia credits you use each month
calc_note: The calculator uses Starter and the Pro credit tiers, counted per month: on yearly billing Synthesia gives the year's credits up front (for example 72,000 a year on Pro, which is 6,000 a month). Paid plan credits come on top of the free allowance of the Basic plan, 500 credits a month. A typical finished minute of video uses about 100 credits, more if the avatar is on screen throughout.

faq: Basic is free. Starter costs $19/month, or $14/month billed yearly ($168/year). Pro starts at $89/month, or $59/month billed yearly ($708/year), for 6,000 credits a month and goes up to $676/month ($448/month yearly) for 48,000. Enterprise is custom.
Yes. The Basic plan is $0 with 500 credits and 10 minutes of video a month. Videos carry a Synthesia watermark.
How many credits does a minute of video use?

Synthesia counts the avatar footage generated, not the length of the finished video. A typical finished minute uses about 100 credits, more if the avatar is on screen throughout. Dubbing uses 80 credits per minute with lip-sync and 40 without.

On monthly billing, Starter's first month is $9 (then $19/month). Pro's first month is $49 with 6,000 credits a month (then $89/month), $95 with 12,000, $179 with 24,000, $259 with 36,000 and $329 with 48,000.
